{"rewrites":[{"sql":"SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.total_cents FROM public.orders o WHERE o.created_at < $1 OR (o.created_at = $1 AND o.id < $2) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT $3","transformation":"Expanded the ROW(...) < ROW(...) comparison into its equivalent disjunctive (OR) form so each branch is independently sargable; with NOT NULL columns the row comparison never involves NULLs, so the expansion is exact.","assumptions":[{"kind":"not_null","table":"public.orders","column":"created_at"},{"kind":"not_null","table":"public.orders","column":"id"}]},{"sql":"SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.total_cents FROM public.orders o WHERE o.created_at <= $1 AND (o.created_at < $1 OR o.id < $2) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT $3","transformation":"Rewrote the row comparison as a leading-range predicate (created_at <= $1) combined with a residual disjunction, giving the planner a tight single-column range it can scan first before applying the id condition.","assumptions":[{"kind":"not_null","table":"public.orders","column":"created_at"},{"kind":"not_null","table":"public.orders","column":"id"}]},{"sql":"SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.total_cents FROM (SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.total_cents FROM public.orders o WHERE o.created_at < $1 UNION ALL SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.total_cents FROM public.orders o WHERE o.created_at = $1 AND o.id < $2) o ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT $3","transformation":"Split the row comparison into two mutually exclusive UNION ALL branches (strictly earlier created_at, or equal created_at with smaller id) so no row can be duplicated, then ordered and limited the combined set.","assumptions":[{"kind":"not_null","table":"public.orders","column":"created_at"},{"kind":"not_null","table":"public.orders","column":"id"}]}]}
